title: Weierstrass semigroups at totally ramified places of degree one on Kummer extensions
summary: We explicitly describe the set of gaps and the Weierstrass semigroup at a totally ramified place of degree one on a Kummer extension defined by the affine equation $y^m = f(x)$ over $K$, an algebraic extension of $\mathbb{F}_q$, where $f(x)\in K(x)$. Our description takes a unified form for distinct totally ramified places of degree one. We then provide a necessary and sufficient condition for the Weierstrass semigroup at a totally ramified place of degree one to be symmetric. Furthermore, we investigate the minimal generating set of the Weierstrass semigroups at many totally ramified places…
